observations: Single photo shows a blue-painted industrial gearbox housing, roughly cylindrical with mounting flanges on two sides.
A black cylindrical cap/adapter with an eyebolt sits on top, likely an input or output shaft cover.
Two small metal labels (one yellow, one silver) are visible on the housing but text is too small/blurred to read.
Two threaded ports or fittings are visible on the lower housing, possibly for oil fill/drain or sensors.
Image has a 'POSTED ON JIJI / WISDOM GLOBAL' watermark overlay, not seller-applied markings on the item itself.
No nameplate, serial number, or 'XWD8' marking is legible anywhere in the photo.
No shots of the item running, shaft rotating, internals, or packaging/box.

claims.claim: Original gear box XWD8 is available
claims.evidence: No nameplate text or model marking 'XWD8' is legible in photo 0; label plates are present but unreadable.

risks.risk: Model/spec rating (torque, ratio, size) cannot be confirmed, and this is the main price driver for a gearbox.
risks.proof: Close-up, in-focus photo of the nameplate/label showing model, ratio, and serial number.
risks.if_unproven: cannot be priced at all without this, since gearbox value varies by orders of magnitude by spec

risks.risk: Claim of 'original' (genuine OEM) vs rebuilt or counterfeit unit cannot be checked remotely.
risks.proof: Clear nameplate photo plus manufacturer verification or purchase invoice.

risks.risk: Functional condition (shaft rotation, gear wear, backlash, seal leaks) is unknown from a static photo.
risks.proof: Video of input shaft being turned by hand or under motor load, and of output shaft responding smoothly.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working / needs rebuild

risks.risk: Internal gear/bearing condition and oil state cannot be seen from outside.
risks.proof: Photo/video of oil drain sample and, if possible, opened inspection cover.
risks.if_unproven: priced as needing full internal rebuild

risks.risk: Surface rust/paint may be hiding corrosion or past water damage on flanges and shaft.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of flange edges, shaft surface, and underside of unit.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having cosmetic and possible structural wear

proof_requests: Clear, well-lit close-up of the nameplate/label showing brand, model (confirming XWD8), ratio, and serial number.
Video of the gearbox shaft being rotated by hand or under power to show it turns freely without grinding noise.
Photo of oil drained from the unit, or confirmation of oil level/color through sight glass.
Close-up photos of mounting flanges, shaft end, and housing seams for rust, cracks, or leaks.
Any purchase invoice, warranty card, or manufacturer documentation supporting 'original' claim.
response.reason: The item is identifiable only as a generic industrial gearbox since the nameplate and claimed 'XWD8' model are illegible in the single photo, and gearbox value depends heavily on exact spec, so no meaningful worst-case price can be set without a readable nameplate.
